**You can test this DAPP ; it's already deployed [here](http
summary: Demonstrate wallet account integration with the Starknet blockchain using Wallet API.
description_long: This project showcases a DAPP that interacts with the Starknet blockchain through the Wallet API, allowing users to manage accounts securely in their web browser. It addresses the challenge of handling wallet transactions by requiring a wallet signature for operations, while also enabling direct blockchain interactions through a specified provider. The application is built using Next.js and TypeScript, and includes a custom UI for selecting wallets installed in the browser.

2372:# Starknet Privacy Starter Kit

A lean Next.js starter for building privacy dApps on Starknet with [STRK20](https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/474) via `WalletAccountV6` (starknet.js v10). Shield, unshield,
summary: Build privacy dApps on Starknet using Next.js with integrated wallet features.
description_long: This project provides a Next.js starter kit for creating privacy-focused decentralized applications on Starknet. It includes features like wallet selection, token shielding, unshields, private transfers, and balance reads, all handled via the user's wallet without relying on a viewing key. The technical challenge involves configuring secure interactions with the Starknet blockchain using the STRK20 protocol and handling user input effectively.
